title: Chapter 313 The Way Out For The Leader Of Nanshan Society
content:
Chapter 313 The Way Out For The Leader Of Nanshan Society

Wana Town Lord's Mansion.

Wang Shuo called the lords of Nanshan Society together.

"Brothers of Nanshan Society, today we are calling you here to send troops to rescue Haihe City."

"Before discussing, everyone, you can take a look at the rankings. Our Nanshan Society's two lords, Liu Zhiming and Wen Yifan, performed very bravely in the rescue of Changping County."

"I will give the heart of the town to them according to the previous agreement."

After that, Wang Shuo took out two hearts of the town and handed them to the two.

This move made the eyes of others straight.

Especially those lords who participated in the battle but slacked all the way, they felt even worse at this time.

In order to preserve their strength, they always followed at the end of the battle, and the number of enemies killed, especially the number of generals killed, was much less than that of these two lords.

"This is what you deserve. I hope that in the next battle, we can work together and create glory again."

"Thank you, leader."

Wang Shuo nodded to the two with satisfaction.

"Next, we will go to Haihe City. I hope that more brothers can participate in this operation."

"After all, in this world, if you keep avoiding, you will be eliminated in the end."

"Only by constantly facing challenges and improving your strength can you have the opportunity to stand out and grow stronger."

"The leader said well."

"This time, Gaotang Village will definitely follow the leader's steps." Liu Zhiming, who obtained the heart of the town, immediately expressed his position.

"I still have 3 town hearts here. After this war, if we are all still alive, the three villages with the highest combat power will get the heart of the town."

After Wang Shuo finished speaking, the lords were eager to move. Many lords regretted not participating in the last operation or not working hard to kill the enemy.

"Okay, I won't say much else. You go back and arrange the affairs in the territory first. One day later, we will gather in Changping County."

After everyone left, Wang Shuo summoned the core personnel of the territory again.

"Wenxi, are you still busy enough to take care of the three cities?"

"Boss, you don't know that Changping County is much bigger than our Wana Town. I still have a lot of things to figure out."

"Don't worry, take your time. Future development will still be based on our Wana Town. You can move some useful talents to Wana Town."

The biggest advantage of Wana Town is that the qualification level of the people is +1, and there are various bonuses.

Wang Shuo was still reluctant to give up such a good innate advantage.

"In addition, you should also start to reserve various talents, such as agents in Nanshanji and Changping County. You must select people with 100% loyalty. This matter must not be sloppy. When you have the right candidate, report to me first."

"Yes, boss."

Afterwards, Wang Shuo transferred Li Weiguo to Nanshanji for garrison, and Li Baoguo to Changping County for defense.

As for specific government affairs, Duan Wenxi was still responsible for coordinating the three places.

Then, he asked about the population, construction, and various production conditions of the territory.

Finally, he looked at Ayub.

"Abu, how is the expansion of our territory's army going now?"

"My Lord, after a series of fierce battles, the Red Flame Army has lost thousands of people, but our territory has enough reserve personnel, especially the tools are refreshed every day, so I have followed your request and increased the Red Flame Army's standing combat power to 10,000 people."
